title: Binance cross-chain theft: 233.46M XRP isolated in attacker account; Circle/Ripple issuer freezes; FBI TraderTraitor attribution

valuation_and_scale.interpretation: Stress-scale comparison only. The wallet was not observed selling in the latest cited on-chain snapshot; volume and depth are provider-scoped.

cctp_path.interpretation: CCTP was used as a public transfer rail in the laundering path. No evidence indicates Circle intentionally facilitated the activity; Circle separately froze identified USDC balances.

issuer_actions.xrp_freeze_capability: No issuer can freeze native XRP at the protocol level.
issuer_actions.rlusd_freeze_capability: Ripple can freeze issuer-controlled RLUSD; the cited incident freeze was on Ethereum ERC-20 RLUSD.

law_enforcement.scope: Overall Binance theft exceeding $6B, not a separately named XRP account attribution
law_enforcement.note: The FBI alert's published address list contains Ethereum addresses; it does not list the XRPL attacker account. The official attribution applies to the incident as a whole.

binance_recovery.remaining_10pct: Less-liquid tokens outside the top ten
binance_recovery.withdrawal_reopening: Company said on track for Sunday 2026-11-01; this notice did not confirm that withdrawals had reopened.
binance_recovery.interpretation: 100% customer-asset coverage is not recovery of the stolen XRP. It does not prove Binance bought 233.46M XRP in spot markets.

market_snapshot.comparison_warning: CoinGecko's $3.46B open interest differs materially from the earlier TradRadar $1.87B snapshot. Provider coverage and timestamps differ; do not average. Other historical volume aggregators also diverge substantially.

source_discrepancies.resolution: Different chain coverage, cutoffs, valuation times and categories; preserve provider-specific values.

source_evidence.supports: 90% replenishment; XRP and RLUSD in top ten reported 100% backed; funding sources; 31 Oct PoR snapshot; full proof estimated Nov 3; withdrawals still only targeted for Sunday.
233.46M XRP theft; five Binance XRPL wallets; North Korean TraderTraitor assessment; 40.5M RLUSD frozen; 48M sold before freeze; 823M USDC frozen.

source_independence.TRM_Bitquery_Elliptic: Separate analytics providers using public chain data; not fully independent in all methods and may share underlying public data or corroborating sources.
source_independence.FBI: Independent official attribution for the overall incident.
source_independence.Binance: Primary source for its own recovery and reserve claims; company-reported, pending full PoR proof.
source_independence.CoinGecko: Aggregated market data; venue scope and quote timestamp are not fully exposed in this capture.

limitations: No direct raw XRPL RPC response was retrieved in this run.
The latest independent attacker-account balance observation is Bitquery at 2026-10-31 16:51 UTC, 8.28 hours before this capture; current balance after that is unknown.
The FBI alert attributes the overall incident but does not list the XRPL attacker address.
Binance's 100% XRP customer-coverage statement is not proof that the stolen XRP was recovered or that an equal amount was bought in spot markets.
CoinGecko quote timestamp is not exposed; current market metrics are indicative and not admitted to the historical feature store.
The $28M Crypto Times headline conflicts with its own body and with independent sources; exclude that headline value.
The incident's total-loss and freeze totals differ across providers; preserve each provider's scope and cutoff.
